name: git
summary: git — the gucOS git CLI over libgit2 1.9.0: init, add, commit, branch, checkout and config (the #475 write set), log, show, diff, status, rev-list, rev-parse, cat-file and ls-tree, and the #478 network leg — clone, fetch, fast-forward pull, push and remote over smart HTTP(S), with credentials from ~/.git-credentials. The repository is discovered from the current directory as in git. merge/tag/reset are not implemented yet.
